title: question-etiquette
prompt: Design the caching layer for this service. There are at least two real open questions in here -- what to use as the eviction policy, and whether entries should be namespaced per tenant -- go ahead and ask me whatever you need before you commit to an approach.
non_adoption_baseline: Unlabeled bullet questions, or no questions asked at all before committing to a design -- both adopted:false.
notes: setup writes a bare cache.py with no eviction/tenancy logic, nothing else. verify reads .transcript.txt and requires at least two '^Q\\d+[.)]' lines, each with at least one lettered sub-item, and at least one escape phrasing ('something else'/'tell me'/free text) among the options -- this is a first-pass regex heuristic against raw PTY-rendered transcript text (word-wrapping, box-drawing characters, or differing claude/opencode rendering could break it); tighten once real transcripts are observed, per PROTOCOL.md's own stance on unverified assumptions.
